title: Harden and de-duplicate CI policy evidence workflows
scope: Eliminate repeated PR scanner installation and collection
Separate trusted platform posture collection from untrusted PR code
Make Terraform and release build environments reproducible
Consolidate duplicated policy validation without changing required check names
nonGoals: Push, publish, deploy, rotate credentials, or modify branch protection
acceptanceCriteria: PR policy evaluation consumes one scanner-evidence contract rather than reinstalling scanners
Trusted posture uses default-branch collector and policy code
Container base and direct binary downloads are integrity pinned
Terraform and release tool dependencies are declared reproducibly
Harness and relevant CI tests pass
